title: Small threshold-family exterior weight bound
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $\epsilon\in\mathbb{R}$. The sum of the squared Fourier coefficients of its real-valued version over sets outside the family of sets of size at most $k$ contained in the coordinates whose Boolean influence is at least $\epsilon^2 I^{-2}9^{-k}$ is at most the sum over sets outside the family consisting of those coordinate subsets together with all sets of size greater than $k$, plus the sum over sets of size greater than $k$; here $I$ is the total influence of the real-valued version of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
